toolu_01HQCMwkxiRiwFpVTVmCu2E9.description: Compare OKLCH values of the two coral colors

detail: Comparing OKLCH values of the two coral colors

content.text:
Yes, there was a noticeable visual change—the color got **significantly darker**:

| Metric | Original | Adjusted | Change |
|--------|----------|----------|--------|
| **Lightness** | 0.63 | 0.52 | −0.11 (17% darker) |
| **Chroma** | 0.2 | 0.2 | — (no change) |
| **Hue** | 15.73° | 15.79° | ≈ no change |

The new color (#bf103f) keeps the same coral/red hue and saturation, but it's noticeably darker. Since OKLCH is perceptually uniform, that 0.11 drop in lightness is pretty meaningful—it's the kind of shift you'd definitely notice side-by-side. The color remains in the same coral family but feels more like a deep burgundy-red now.
